fm_lbfgs_convergence.qubo_branch_note: v1_FM_LBFGS_QUBO uses the identical fit_onehot_fm_lbfgs(maxiter=600) optimizer; per-round convergence flags in this archived 20-seed JSON were recorded on v1_FM_LBFGS_SeqRank (300/300).

protocol_scope_notes.same_surrogate_comparison: Under the same lightweight online physics-hurdle surrogate (K=200, V<0.5 M=18), v2_Real_8Bit_QUBO achieved 16.20/18 (SD 1.077) vs 16.55/18 (SD 1.962) for v2_Classical_SeqRank (-0.35 targets, -1.94 pp), supporting hybrid classical-prescreen + QUBO feasibility without claiming acquisition-level or quantum advantage. Marginal across-seed SDs are reported; per-seed paired trajectories were not archived.
protocol_scope_notes.a_eq_b_eligibility: 03_val has 3,969 rows including 77 homonuclear (A=B) rows (0 targets with V<1, min V=6.65373). Initial 50-sample pools and Random/SeqRank draw from all 3,969 rows (E[H_0.5(200)]=0.9070295), whereas v2_Real_8Bit_QUBO excludes A=B in its QUBO decoding (non-homonuclear pool N=3,892 gives E[H_0.5(200)]=0.9249743).

equal_budget_solver_topk.protocol: Equal-budget n_runs=50, 1 best shot/run (50 returned shots) on identical frozen V_hat
